# Sebastian Johansson — Hibbisoft

> Independent software developer and ecommerce consultant. Building software since 2006 and running Hibbisoft (HibbiSoft AB), a one-person consultancy, since 2017. For businesses, product teams and startups across industries in the Malmö–Lund–Copenhagen region.

Expertise includes .NET, C#, React, TypeScript, MongoDB, Azure, Optimizely, Voyado Engage, Voyado Elevate, Kustom and Klarna. Sebastian has Agile and Scrum experience and uses Codex and Claude for AI-assisted software development.

The site presents a CV as a playful ecommerce shop. The cart selects areas of expertise for a project inquiry; it does not sell products, accept payment or book time. Availability, scope and rates are discussed directly. Inquiries use the website contact form or LinkedIn.

## Profile and experience

- [Complete profile in Markdown](https://hibbisoft.se/index.md): Biography, three services, all 20 projects, career history, education, languages and contact options, reflecting the website's visible content.

- [Software development services](https://hibbisoft.se/#expertise): Backend and architecture, frontend and product development, ecommerce and integrations.
- [Project experience](https://hibbisoft.se/#experience): Project descriptions, dates, contributions and technologies.
- [Start a project inquiry](https://hibbisoft.se/#contact): Discuss a project and availability with Sebastian.
